repo_notes.content: forkfix is a small FastAPI + SQLite service (app/) that turns a GitHub issue labeled devin:fixplease on the fork dmonroym0/superset into Devin sessions: a read-only triage session that judges CVE reachability, a per-issue routing decision (app/router.py), and a fix session that opens a draft PR. It runs in DEMO mode with fake GitHub/Devin clients (app/fake_github.py, app/fake_devin.py) and in LIVE mode against GitHub and Devin API v3. Prioritize the issue state machine (app/pipeline.py, app/db.py), the ACU budget ledger (app/budget.py), routing rules, the playbooks in playbooks/, and the dashboard (app/dashboard.py, app/metrics.py, app/templates/, app/static/, app/i18n/). Source of truth for behavior is README.md and features.md; README.es.md is a translation.
repo_notes.author: dmonroym0

repo_notes.content: The English pages use English. Pages under the parent page 'Documentación en español' are an experiment: write them entirely in Latin American Spanish (es-419), addressing the reader as tú, and keep these engineering terms in English: CVE, PR, ACU, Devin, playbook, DeepWiki, issue, pipeline, webhook, upstream, fork. Use docs/es/GLOSSARY.md for every other term (for example ceiling = tope, cap = límite, sweep = búsqueda, triage = triaje). Keep code identifiers, file paths, env var names and commands verbatim.
repo_notes.author: dmonroym0

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What forkfix does end to end, who it is for, DEMO vs LIVE mode, and how the pieces in app/ fit together. Include the flow from labeled issue to draft PR.

pages.title: Issue lifecycle and state machine
pages.purpose: The issue states in app/models.py and app/db.py (seen, queued_budget, triaging, triaged, fixing, pr_opened, needs_human, not_reachable, error, cancelled), the compare-and-set transitions, and how the webhook and the sweep avoid double processing.

pages.title: Triage, routing and fix sessions
pages.purpose: How app/triage.py, app/router.py and app/fix.py create Devin sessions from the playbooks in playbooks/, the structured triage output schema in schemas/, and the routing rules (fix, needs_human, close_low_priority).

pages.title: ACU budget ledger
pages.purpose: app/budget.py: per-session caps (triage 5, fix 15), the global ceiling, reservations and releases, and what happens when a reservation is refused (queued_budget).

pages.title: GitHub and Devin integration
pages.purpose: app/github_client.py, app/devin_client.py, app/webhook.py and app/sweep.py: webhook signature checks, the sweep, labels and comments, Devin API v3 calls, and the fake clients used in DEMO mode.

pages.title: Upstream sync
pages.purpose: app/upstream_sync.py and app/changelog.py: the scheduled sync from apache/superset into the fork and the changelog PR.

pages.title: Dashboard and telemetry
pages.purpose: app/dashboard.py, app/metrics.py, app/templates/ and app/static/: the overview, pipeline, issue detail, sessions and cost views, the /metrics.json fields, in-place polling, and the rule that no history is invented.

pages.title: Localization
pages.purpose: app/i18n/ (en.json, es.json, Translator, Accept-Language negotiation, the forkfix_lang cookie), docs/es/GLOSSARY.md, and the tests that enforce key parity and no hard-coded English in templates.

pages.title: Configuration and deployment
pages.purpose: app/config.py environment variables, app/preflight.py checks, the Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml, and how to run DEMO and LIVE.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The tests/ suite, how DEMO end-to-end runs work (scripts/simulate_webhook.py), and the lint and test commands.
